rationale: THE USES HALF OF THE OWNER CHANNEL (2026-11-17, JS-twin parity). A member READ now carries metadata.owner + metadata.ownerEvidence from the same per-file receiver facts the calls pass uses — the keys member-owner-resolution.ts reads to withdraw the name binding and re-resolve inside the owner. The channel is pinned on the four syntactic forms the lane's calls side already covers (this.<field>, assignment from new, param annotation, array element) and the honest other half is pinned too: a read through an untyped local must state NO owner AND carry typescriptUnresolvedReceiver, because a member name on an untyped receiver cannot identify a declaration. The forbid is scoped to meta.owner=Widget so it fails only on an over-claim (the row itself is legitimate and must exist).

expectRelationships.note: THE GAIN: the read of this.inner.value states the receiver's type — before this change the uses half of the channel was empty (0 of 606 rows on a 200-file stride)
const w = new Widget(): the new expression is the evidence, on the READ side
w: Widget — annotation evidence on a read
items: Widget[] — the subscript states the element, one hop
THE CONTROL: the row exists (the read is real) but states no owner and carries the marker, so the store withdraws the name binding instead of guessing

forbidRelationships.note: a member name on an untyped receiver must never be given an owner — the marker is the honest half, not an owner
